h5_latency.cache_assumption: warm: one discarded request per window before sampling
h5_latency.finding: delta-only is the SLOWEST despite returning fewer days than base-only (41 vs 51). Delta is t1/s256 geometry -- one chunk per day -- so a 41-day delta read touches ~41 chunks per variable, while base's (90,8,8) chunking serves 51 days from far fewer. This is §10.1's claim that cadence, not block size, governs the read cost of the delta tail, measured on production for the first time.
